text: Assemble very crude makeshift weapons, prone to jamming and very unreliable.
An improvised, rough, ancient-design pattern blowback-operated self-loading pistol. It lacks stopping power and range and is prone to jamming.
A small, home-made micro-submachine gun. It's short range and very prone to jamming due to the rough design and faulty elements. Its rate of fire tends to make up for its weakness.

A general-purpose gas-operated improvised assault rifle, utilising various salvaged components mounted on a militia rifle receiver. It has good range, decent power, and good accuracy, but is prone to jamming.
An improvised design powerful shotgun that emits a large barrage of pellets. Deadly, but short range. Due to numerous faults in design, the amount of pellets fired varies shot by shot.

An improvised, gas-operated light machine gun. Unwieldy and inaccurate, it is also very prone to jamming. Its long bursts of fire are effective against groups of enemies, but their shot counts are completely random.
